steps: Place 150 g of blueberries in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Cook the blueberries for 5 to 7 minutes, stirring often, until they burst and release their juice.
Remove from heat and mash the cooked blueberries lightly with a fork.
Stir in 20 g of chia seeds and 60 ml of coconut milk into the warm blueberry mixture.
Add 2 ml of vanilla extract and stir to combine; let the mixture rest for 5 minutes until slightly thickened.
Divide 240 ml of coconut yogurt evenly among 4 small jars or cups.
Spoon the blueberry chia mixture over the coconut yogurt in each cup.
Serve immediately or cover and refrigerate; keeps for up to 2 days in sealed jars.
